name: Masseur of Romance
detailed_description:
Disclaimer: This game is a fictional story set in an alternate universe and is not related to any real-world organizations, companies, individuals, or groups. Please do not associate it with reality.

[Announcement]

The Choice of the Apocalypse is set to release a playable demo in October, with the full version launching in 2026!

[Game Summary]

The catastrophe struck without warning, toppling the world as we knew it. The old order has crumbled to ashes, and survival is now the only rule.

Will you carve out your own dominion, amass resources, and fortify your stronghold to become a warlord in this lawless wasteland?

Or will you take up the torch, pierce through the darkness, and seek the truth behind the disaster—risking everything to defy fate and become the savior of a broken world?

The apocalypse begins with your choice.

[Game Features]

This game blends post-apocalyptic survival, base-building strategy, and tabletop RPG elements, plunging you into a perilous yet boundless world.

Four core disaster systems intertwine, each bringing its own horrors:

- The eerie whispers of Cthulhu loom over the land.

- Zombie hordes devour what remains of modern civilization.

- Rogue AI machines wield advanced technology against humanity.

- Radioactive wastelands mutate both the environment and those who dare to tread within.

Every inch of this world is fraught with danger—and opportunity.

Build, strategize, and survive:

- Upgrade your base, manage resources, and plan defenses to protect your survivors.

- Encounter dynamic events and NPCs—some desperate for help, others scheming in the shadows.

- Face relentless threats: will you fight head-on or outsmart your enemies?

Every dialogue choice, every battle decision, rolls the dice on your fate.

From eldritch horrors testing your sanity to zombie sieges fighting for supplies, from AI-controlled tech warfare to mutant-infested radiation zones, the game offers a rich bestiary and interactive environments, ensuring no two adventures are the same.

Your choices will ultimately weave a unique ending—will you be the hero who saves the world, or the survivor who watches it burn?

The apocalypse is yours to write.

short_description: This domestic male-oriented dating sim and management game lets you experience a journey blending love and management as a male beautician and physiotherapist. Featuring various fun mini-games, it lets you craft a unique ending through business management and plot choices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10及更新版本
  • Processor: Intel Core2DUO 2GHz以上性能的中央处理器
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 对应DirectX9.0 VRAM128MB以上的显卡
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 支持PCM的声卡
